_meta.source: Shogun Showdown wiki, Enemies, Bosses and Daisuke the Dasher pages (shogunshowdown.wiki.gg), fetched 2026-10-28, CC BY-SA 4.0; plus the Stage 1 domain model for what the bot measured.

fields.hp, hp_day5: [wiki] max HP on Day 1 and from Day 5; null = not listed
fields.tiles: catalogue tile ids the unit carries [wiki]; the first one is the tile the simulator loads by default
fields.region: region where the unit is first seen [wiki]
fields.tag: one-letter tag used in board renders and logs
fields.sim: true when rules.py has behaviour presets for the unit

traits.name: Aggro
traits.text: After attacking, moves toward the player.

traits.name: Quick
traits.text: Can attack immediately after a tile is added to its attack queue.

traits.name: Explosive
traits.text: On death, explodes for 2 damage to units in adjacent cells.

traits.name: Dash
traits.text: When moving, advances as far as possible in the chosen direction.

elite_traits.name: Quick
elite_traits.text: Can attack immediately after a tile is added to the attack queue.

elite_traits.name: Double-Striker
elite_traits.text: Performs the attack twice; multi-attack enemies double-strike their last attack.

elite_traits.name: Reactive Shield
elite_traits.text: Gains a shield automatically after taking damage.

elite_traits.name: Corrupted
elite_traits.text: On death, spawns a Corrupted Progeny in its place (Day 7 only).

elite_rules: All enemies have elite variants from Day 2; Warden and Shielder cannot be elite [wiki].

enemies.name: Ashigaru
enemies.text: Common swordsman. Often steps away after swinging [obs].

enemies.name: Twin Tachi
enemies.text: Attacks even if it may hit allies.

enemies.name: Spike Charger
enemies.text: Charges using spiked armour. Charges only with a clear lane to the hero [user]; never turns away when facing the hero [user].

enemies.name: Yari Master
enemies.text: Long-reach spear user; attacks even if it hits allies.

enemies.name: Yumi Sniper
enemies.text: Marksman who attacks from the back lines [wiki]. A soldier with two banners on its back; 3 HP pips like the Ashigaru, told apart by the Volley in its bubble ('2' and arrows rising and falling). It mostly held its cell: one step away from the hero after firing in recording 2 (f0229-f0231), otherwise it moved only when the hero swapped with it, and it turns [rec: collect/20261029-160032 f0194-f0344; bot: run 20261030-115221 t171-t178, t188-t190, t207-t210, t231-t233]. Met in Hibiku Wastelands (recording 2), it also came to Moonlit Port (regions.json 'visitors'). Simulated since 0.35 with the learned model.

enemies.name: Guardian
enemies.text: Relentlessly advances on enemies. Aggro [wiki: 'after attacking, moves toward the player']: after 2 of its 3 attacks in recording 2 its next telegraph was a step toward the hero, after the third a load [rec: collect/20261029-160032 f0605, f0656, f0708]; simulated with the learned model's kind-free levels until bot runs show it (0.31).

enemies.name: Ashigaru Archer
enemies.text: Waits behind enemy lines for an opening. In the recordings it stood on the far edge with its Arrow loaded while the other units fought [rec: collect/20261028-190026 f0347-f0380]; 2 HP pips like a Tachi, told apart by the Arrow in its bubble. Simulated with the learned model's kind-free levels until bot runs show it (0.31).

enemies.name: Grappler
enemies.text: Spirit Gateway (levels I and III in both recordings) [wiki: Enemies: HP 5 (6), Grappling Hook + Sword]. A slim hunched unit in a black hood with a round orange lantern-eye on top, red chest and shoulder plates and a small white hook in its hand; it swings a grey coil when due to fire. It has the Guardian's 5 HP pips; the Hook in its bubble, always the lower tile under the Sword, names it. Grappling Hook [wiki: Tiles]: 'Pull the first target to the cell directly ahead', 1 damage. Its pull on the hero was never seen (the player always killed or turned it first) [gap]; simulated since 0.36 as the wiki says, the Sword then hitting the cell ahead. [rec: collect/20261028-190026 f0600-f0853, collect/20261029-160032 f0801-f1065]

behaviour.source: [wiki: Enemies, Tiles] [rec: collect/20261028-190026 f0600-f0853, collect/20261029-160032 f0801-f1065] It loads the Grappling Hook ('+'), then at once the Sword above it ('+' again), holds one phase red (R1), then fires both in one phase, the Hook first, at the first unit ahead at any distance (rec1 f0776-f0779; rec2 f0816-f0821, f0824-f0833, f0866-f0871); it held while an ally blocked its lane (rec1 f0615-f0621, f0823-f0828), and a lane the hero opened was used the phase after (rec1 f0827-f0829). After firing it turns to the hero and reloads; none of the 10 stepped on its own.

enemies.name: Shinobi
enemies.text: Spirit Gateway (levels II and III in both recordings) [wiki: Enemies: HP 4 (5), Quick, Shuriken or Smoke Bomb]. A small black hooded figure with a white mask, one large red eye and red stripes, crouched, a white blade held low. It has the Yari Master's 4 HP pips; the Shuriken (a '1' and a four-pointed star) or the Smoke Bomb (a '1', a smoke cloud with a black up-arrow and an ember) in its bubble names it. Smoke Bomb [wiki: Tiles]: 'Swap position with the first target ahead', 1 damage: the Shinobi on cell 5 and the hero on cell 1 changed places, both keeping their facing, and the hero lost 1 (rec1 f0708-f0709). It stepped away after a Shuriken once (rec1 f0713-f0717) and otherwise held its cell. Simulated since 0.36. [rec: collect/20261028-190026 f0600-f0853, collect/20261029-160032 f0801-f1065]

behaviour.source: [wiki: Enemies; Traits: Quick, 'can attack immediately after adding a tile to the attack queue'] [rec: collect/20261028-190026 f0600-f0853, collect/20261029-160032 f0801-f1065] The first load was the Shuriken in all 7 seen (rec1 f0672, f0694, f0736, f0842; rec2 f0892, f0953, f1052); one unit alternated Shuriken, Smoke Bomb, Shuriken, Smoke Bomb (rec1 f0694-f0718). Quick in play: the tile fires the phase right after the one it was loaded in, with no hold (rec1 f0693-f0695 and f0710-f0713, rec2 f0891-f0895: 1 damage each), never in the loading phase; it held while an ally blocked its lane (rec1 f0736-f0745, rec2 f0953-f0958), and a lane the hero opened was not used that phase (rec1 f0744-f0745, rec2 f0957-f0958). Its bubble may read red on a single frame and still fire.

enemies.name: Shielder
enemies.text: Defends allies; carries Ally Shield or Shield. Cannot be elite.

enemies.name: Warden
enemies.text: Lives in a strider shell with a lantern; summons Blight Chargers. Cannot be elite.

enemies.name: Strider
enemies.text: Fallen warrior, appears in numbers after the Scarring.

enemies.name: Kabukai
enemies.text: Trickster that mirrors your moves.

enemies.name: Shadow Charger
enemies.text: Appears in Hideyoshi's Keep, Nobunaga's Fortress and Ieyasu's Garden.

enemies.name: Dummy
enemies.spawned_from: the Astronomer in parts of the tutorial

enemies.name: Summoner

behaviour.source: [wiki: The Statue: the Summoner is 'synced with the Statue to Summon a random enemy after the Statue puts his first Tile into his Attack Queue'] [rec: collect/20261028-190026 f0857-f0924, collect/20261029-160032 f1071-f1125] It loads its bell with the Statue's first load of a cycle and summons with the Statue's second load (rec1 T2-T4 and T11-T13, rec2 T2-T4); one unit a cycle: Ashigaru twice, Twin Tachi once; it never moves or attacks.

enemies.text: Present at the start of The Statue's fight on the first cell [wiki: The Statue, HP 15, Heavy]. Its 15 HP pips stand in three rows of five under its plate; it never moves or attacks. Summon pool [wiki]: Ashigaru, Twin Tachi, Yari Master, Yumi Sniper; the planner summons an Ashigaru on the empty cell farthest from the hero [hyp]. [rec: collect/20261028-190026 f0857-f0924, collect/20261029-160032 f1071-f1125]

enemies.name: Daisuke the Dasher

behaviour.source: [bot] Charge is followed by Sword, loaded a phase apart (29 of 29 in behaviour.json; run 20261028-053637 turns 120-123, 130-133)

corrupted.text: Uses Charge + Sword and Summon much more often.

enemies.text: First Bamboo Grove boss. Often Sword or Swirl, then moves toward the player; sometimes Charge + Sword (loaded in two phases [bot]); occasionally summons a Spike Charger. HP is the boss bar.

enemies.name: Rei the Ruthless

behaviour.source: [bot: her five fights, runs 20261029-072323, -095311, -100218, -101549, -103242, re-read with the 0.27 icons] opening: every fight began with the red bell (two Twin Tachi); combos: Charge was always followed by Dragon Punch (10 of 10) and Back Charge by Summon (2 of 2), loaded a phase apart; loads: the first tile she loaded, by distance to the hero (1, 2, 3 or more), the opening left out

corrupted.text: Summons Twin Tachi more often and uses Dragon Punch more often [wiki].

enemies.text: Alternate Bamboo Grove boss once the Shogun has been beaten [wiki], also on Day 1 [bot: run 20261029-072323]. HP 13 (Day 5+: 18); 7-cell arena, she starts on the seventh cell and the player on the fourth [wiki]. Dragon Punch is her most common attack; Charge + Dragon Punch; Back Charge + Summon (she retreats and Twin Tachi appear in front of her); Summon, and Summon with Double-Strike (the red bell: two Twin Tachi) [wiki] [bot]. She punches her own Twin Tachi into the player for collision damage [wiki] [bot: run 20261029-103242 t91]. A loaded Dragon Punch is walked toward the player and fired when adjacent [bot: run 20261029-100218 t88-t91, t106-t109].

enemies.name: Iwao the Impaler

behaviour.source: [bot: run 20261029-124921 t159-t198] [rec: collect/20261028-190026 f0285-f0318] [wiki] combos: with Earth Impale loaded and the player next to him he adds a Swirl, then fires both (3 of 3: run t184-t187, rec f0289-f0297 and f0313-f0316; wiki: 'When he is adjacent to you with Earth Impale queued, he will add a Swirl before launching the attack'); without the player next to him Earth Impale fires alone (run t165-t167); after_fire: the turn after firing he steps away from the player, or holds when the wall blocks him, and loads the turn after (after each of his 8 shots: 5 steps away, 3 holds at the wall, run t162-t198); approach: loaded with the player out of reach he steps toward him and fires the turn after (run t166, t171, t180; t191 blocked by the player arriving); loads: the first tile he loaded, by distance to the player at the start of the turn (1, 2, 3 or more)

corrupted.text: Phantom Leap + Spear (block it with a unit or stand behind him) and Corrupted Wave.

enemies.text: Whispering Caves boss [wiki]. Earth Impale (brown spikes rising from the ground) hits 2 cells ahead and 2 behind; Swirl never comes alone: with Earth Impale loaded and the player next to him he adds a Swirl on top of it [wiki] [bot: run 20261029-124921 t186; rec: f0292]; Spear (the Yari Master's icon) hits the 2 cells ahead; Summon brings a Yari Master, sometimes a Spike Charger [wiki: Yari Masters much more often] [bot: run 20261029-124921 t177 a Yari Master, t197 a Spike Charger]. The wiki says he mostly uses Earth Impale; run 20261029-124921 loaded Spear 4 times and Earth Impale 2 times at two cells. No ranged attack. HP 25 (Day 5+: 28). Arena 7 cells, Iwao on the fifth, the player on the third [wiki] [bot: run 20261029-124921 t159]. Simulated since 0.28.

enemies.name: The Twins

corrupted.text: Meteor Hammer (can bounce off one Twin into the player) and, on the rear Twin, Corrupted Wave, which heals them [wiki].

behaviour.source: [wiki: The Twins] [rec: collect/20261028-190026 f0544-f0580; collect/20261029-160032 f0727-f0775]. With both Twins on one side of the hero, the rear one loaded Spear (4 of 4) and the front one, next to the hero, Shadow Dash (3 times: the hero 2 or 3 cells from the wall) or Phantom Leap (the Dash tile) then Swap Toss (2 times: the hero on the wall's cell, rec2 f0739, and once 1 cell from it, rec2 f0767; the wiki says at the edge). With the hero between them each loaded a melee tile (Spear 4, Tetsubo 2, Swirl 1) and advanced while loaded.

enemies.text: Moonlit Port boss [wiki]: two units with one HP bar between them (35, 43 from Day 5); each starts on an edge of the 7-cell arena, the hero on the fourth cell. Both died on the same hit [rec: collect/20261028-190026 f0580, collect/20261029-160032 f0775: '+2' skulls over each]. Shadow Dash carries the front Twin through the hero to the cell behind him; Phantom Leap then Swap Toss puts the hero between them again [wiki] [rec: collect/20261029-160032 f0770-f0772].

enemies.name: The Statue

behaviour.source: [wiki: The Statue: 'adds random Tiles in his Attack Queue until it reaches 3 Tiles, after which he will launch the attack'; 'He has a speed debuff, needing an extra turn to add a Tile'; 'The first Tile in the Statue's Queue may be a ranged Tile, but no other Queue position may have a ranged Tile'] [rec: collect/20261028-190026 f0857-f0924, collect/20261029-160032 f1071-f1125] A fixed 9-turn cycle from the hero's first action in both fights (7 fires, 25 loads, no exception): rest, load, rest, load, rest, load, hold, hold, then all three tiles fire, the bottom first, wherever the hero is (2 of the 7 fires reached only a summoned unit). Its first turn shows no telegraph. 'loads': the 9 queues seen, the bottom tile ('first') and the two above it ('later'); the wiki also lists Kunai, not seen.

enemies.text: Spirit Gateway boss [wiki: The Statue: HP 30 (40 from Day 5), Heavy]. It stands on the seventh cell of a 7-cell arena facing left and never moves or turns; the Summoner stands on the first cell and the hero starts on the fourth. Its HP bar fills x 640-1279 (21.3 px per HP; rec1's three hits measured 10, 12 and 8 against the bar). Tiles: Grappling Hook 1, Shuriken 1 and Arrow 2 (ranged, only as the bottom tile), Spear 2, Sword 2, Earth Impale 2, Shadow Kama 3 and Tetsubo 4 (the cells 1-2 ahead). The hero hooked from cell 1 to cell 5 took the Hook's 1 and the Spear's 2 there (rec1 f0868-f0870). On its fire turn the bubble stack blinks yellow or shakes 4 px sideways. [rec: collect/20261028-190026 f0857-f0924, collect/20261029-160032 f1071-f1125]

enemies.name: The Shogun
enemies.text: Two phases [wiki: phase 2 sprite].
